name: MITRE ATT&CK (technique summaries)
title: MITRE ATT&CK — Technique to Detection
description: Concise ATT&CK technique summaries that connect Technique to Prerequisites to Telemetry to Detection to Mitigation, so offensive findings map to defensive coverage. Sourced from the ATT&CK knowledge base and the STIX 2.1 dataset.
licence: MITRE ATT&CK is (c) The MITRE Corporation, available under the ATT&CK Terms of Use with attribution. This pack contains original condensed summaries with attribution and links to attack.mitre.org, not a copy of the corpus.
attribution: MITRE ATT&CK(r) — https://attack.mitre.org/ (c) The MITRE Corporation. STIX 2.1 data: https://github.com/mitre-attack/attack-stix-data.
freshness_policy: Track ATT&CK releases (roughly twice a year); record the ATT&CK version consumed.
